params.body:
Builds on #4 (own stock); its commit is included until it merges.

The detail page in the layout of the Stocklist dealer detail page.

- **Sticky buy box on the right**, beside the gallery and the data: title, price, key specs, feature badges, the three actions (quote, WhatsApp, call), then the seller card: name, address, viewing ("In Oudenburg-Roksem" for own stock, "Op afspraak" for the rest), opening hours, phone, e-mail.
- **Left column**: gallery, technical data, the equipment as a two-column checklist instead of a block of text, then the description.
- **Mobile**: the top bar is replaced by a fixed bar at the bottom with the price, WhatsApp and the quote button, so the main action stays in reach while reading.
- A vehicle that is no longer available keeps its notice and alternatives: no actions, no bar.

Checked in a headless browser: the card stays in view while scrolling on desktop, no script errors; screenshots on the MacBook.
params.title: Detail page: sticky buy box, seller card, equipment list, mobile action bar
